title: 2026 F1 Mexican GP Qualifying analysis by Peter Windsor
description: It's Sir Lewis Hamilton on the pole in Mexico for Ferrari!  The seven-times World Champion drove a superlative lap of the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez to set fastest lap in the closing seconds of Q3, beating Mercedes' George Russell into P2 and Lewis' Ferrari, team-mate, Charles Leclerc, into P3.  Red Bull's Max Verstappen was fourth fastest (and quickest in terms of combined best sector times) but will actually line up P5 (with a grid penalty), behind Kimi Antonelli in the other Merc.
